findings.message: Durable docs now distinguish package-artifact approval from live runtime validation: VULKAN_SM6/SM5-negative evidence is recorded, but visual behavior and hardware RT readback are still not claimed as validated.

Live runtime validation remains open because the agent environment had empty DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY. Future reporting should require a display-capable Vulkan/NVIDIA run with Platform=VULKAN_SM6, dynamic ray tracing enablement, ray tracing shaders enabled, and hardware RT readback confirmed=true before claiming runtime success.
